# sheepdog

[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.22696210.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22696210)
[![License:
MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/LICENSE.md)
[![r-universe](https://diogoprov.r-universe.dev/sheepdog/badges/version)](https://diogoprov.r-universe.dev/sheepdog)

In the fable, the boy cries “wolf!” and the villagers have to decide
whether the wolf is real. **sheepdog** does that check for automated
detections from
[BirdNET](https://github.com/birdnet-team/BirdNET-Analyzer) custom
classifiers in passive acoustic monitoring (PAM). It runs three stages:

1.  **Validation data.** Build clip sets for manual review from the
    BirdNET selection tables: top-score, random-occasion or
    random-recording designs, one folder per species, ready for the
    review tab of the BirdNET GUI. Then summarise the reviewed clips:
    precision by confidence bin, suggested thresholds, confirmed
    presence by night and clips for retraining.
2.  **Calibration.** Turn confidence scores into probabilities of true
    detection with hierarchical logistic models (species and site x
    species effects, compared by cross-validation). Score every
    detection and build nightly detection histories.
3.  **Community matrices.** Turn the calibrated histories into
    effort-standardised site x month matrices for multivariate
    ordinations.

sheepdog was developed for the FrogNet project (anurans of the Pantanal
and Cerrado, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil), but it works with the output
of any BirdNET custom classifier. Its validation outputs feed occupancy
models with false positives fitted with
[crywolf](https://github.com/diogoprov/crywolf). The two packages are
independent: sheepdog does not depend on crywolf.

![The three stages of sheepdog](reference/figures/pipeline.png)

The three stages of sheepdog

## Installation

Install the package from
[r-universe](https://diogoprov.r-universe.dev/sheepdog), which provides
binaries for Windows, macOS and Linux:

``` r

install.packages("sheepdog",
                 repos = c("https://diogoprov.r-universe.dev",
                           "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

The development version can be installed from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("diogoprov/sheepdog")
```

Cutting audio needs [av](https://cran.r-project.org/package=av) (it
bundles ffmpeg), the hierarchical calibration needs
[lme4](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lme4), and the figures need
[ggplot2](https://cran.r-project.org/package=ggplot2):

``` r

install.packages(c("av", "lme4", "ggplot2"))
```

## Calibration performance

For one species, calibration automatically compares global and
site-effect models; with one site, it keeps only estimable candidates.
Explicit model lists remain available in
[`compare_calibration_models()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/compare_calibration_models.md).

The [performance
article](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/articles/performance.html)
summarises the Curiango benchmark, regression checks, computing times
and an explicitly simulated multispecies benchmark. The results do not
show a consistent advantage of one selection rule across datasets.

## Grouped calibration folds

Use `calibrate(..., fold_group = "source_audio")` to keep recordings
intact, or `fold_group = "night"` to keep nights intact across species
at each site. The input validation tables must contain those metadata;
each site needs at least `k_folds` groups. The default remains clip
folds. For a manual workflow, retain the metadata with
`read_validations(..., keep = c("source_audio", "night"))` and inspect
the assignment with
[`calibration_folds()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_folds.md).
See the calibration article for examples and limitations.

## Migrating from 2.x

In 3.0.0, calibration defaults to `select = "one_se_logloss"`. Use
`select = "best_auc"` to preserve the 2.x model selection. See the
[migration
guide](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/articles/migration-3.0.0.html)
for details and comparison of downstream results.

## Usage

``` r

library(sheepdog)

# 1a. Clips to review: check the selection first, then cut
extract_validation_clips("N:/Arara", "N:/Arara/validation",
                         remap_from = "N:/", remap_to = "/Volumes/Arara/",
                         simulate = TRUE)
extract_validation_clips("N:/Arara", "N:/Arara/validation",
                         remap_from = "N:/", remap_to = "/Volumes/Arara/")

# 1b. After the review in the BirdNET GUI
post_validation(review_dir    = "N:/Arara/validation/clips",
                manifest_path = "N:/Arara/validation/clip_manifest.csv",
                output_dir    = "N:/Arara/validation/results")

# 2. Calibration and nightly detection histories
calibrate(validation_files  = c("UEM/validation_by_clip.csv",
                                "ARA/validation_by_clip.csv"),
          prediction_tables = c(UEM = "UEM/BirdNET_SelectionTable.txt",
                                ARA = "ARA/BirdNET_SelectionTable.txt"),
          output_dir        = "calibration")

# 3. Community matrices
build_community_matrices("calibration/nightly_detection_history.csv",
                         "community_matrices",
                         core_species = c("boa_ran", "den_nan", "phy_alb"))
```

Each stage is also available as separate functions:

| Stage | Functions |
|----|----|
| 1\. Selecting and cutting clips | [`read_selection_tables()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/read_selection_tables.md), [`select_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/select_clips.md) (a pure function that returns the clip manifest without touching audio), [`cut_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/cut_clips.md), [`pack_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/pack_clips.md) |
| 1\. Several reviewers | [`assign_reviewers()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/assign_reviewers.md), [`split_by_reviewer()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/split_by_reviewer.md), [`reviewer_agreement()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/reviewer_agreement.md) (Cohen’s or Fleiss’ kappa), [`consensus_verdicts()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/consensus_verdicts.md) |
| 1\. After the review | [`classify_review()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/classify_review.md), [`precision_by_bin()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/precision_by_bin.md), [`suggest_thresholds()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/suggest_thresholds.md), [`nightly_presence()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/nightly_presence.md), [`retraining_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/retraining_clips.md), [`read_validation_tables()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/read_validation_tables.md) |
| 1\. Retraining | [`build_training_set()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/build_training_set.md) (training folders for BirdNET-Analyzer), [`exclude_training_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/exclude_training_clips.md) |
| 2\. Calibration | [`read_validations()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/read_validations.md), [`calibration_models()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_models.md), [`calibration_folds()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_folds.md), [`compare_calibration_models()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/compare_calibration_models.md), [`select_calibration_model()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/select_calibration_model.md), [`fit_calibration()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/fit_calibration.md), [`calibration_effort()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_effort.md), [`score_detections()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/score_detections.md), [`detection_history()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/detection_history.md), [`summarise_history()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/summarise_history.md) |
| 2\. Bayesian calibration | [`calibration_prior()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_prior.md), [`prior_predictive_calibration()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/prior_predictive_calibration.md), [`calibration_diagnostics()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_diagnostics.md), [`calibration_sensitivity()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_sensitivity.md), [`plot_calibration_draws()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/plot_calibration_draws.md), [`history_draws()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/history_draws.md) |
| 3\. Community matrices | [`cell_status()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/cell_status.md), [`suggest_core_species()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/suggest_core_species.md), [`community_matrices()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/community_matrices.md), [`community_matrices_draws()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/community_matrices_draws.md) |

The [articles](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/articles/) cover each
stage with runnable examples;
[`vignette("frognet-workflow")`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/articles/frognet-workflow.md)
shows the complete workflow.

The selection tables must have the standard BirdNET/Raven columns
`Begin Time (s)`, `End Time (s)`, `Species Code`, `Confidence`,
`Begin Path` and `File Offset (s)`, and the recordings must be named
`..._YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS`.

## Sampling designs

[`select_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/select_clips.md)
and
[`extract_validation_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/extract_validation_clips.md)
take `sampling_mode`:

- `"top"` (default) keeps the *N* predictions with the highest
  confidence per site x species x night x hour. It serves retraining and
  the score-to-probability calibration (the model is conditional on the
  score). It does **not** serve to estimate false-positive rates:
  top-score clips hold fewer false positives than a random sample.
- `"random_detections"` follows the observation-confirmation design of
  [Chambert et al. (2015)](https://doi.org/10.1890/14-1507.1): occasions
  with at least one prediction \>= `threshold` are drawn at random
  within strata that do not depend on the score, and every prediction
  \>= `threshold` of a drawn occasion is cut.
- `"random_recordings"` follows the multiple-method design of [Miller et
  al. (2011)](https://doi.org/10.1890/10-1396.1): recordings (or
  minutes) are drawn among all those recorded, with or without
  predictions, for annotation by ear. The clip is the whole recording
  and `confidence` is `NA`.

![The first stage,
extract_validation_clips()](reference/figures/extraction_flow.png)

The first stage, extract_validation_clips()

The manifest records `occasion_id`, `n_detections_occasion` and
`inclusion_prob` (the probability that the occasion was drawn). Every
draw uses a fixed seed, so a rerun selects the same clips, and the cut
is idempotent: an interrupted run resumes where it stopped.

## Calibration

Converting BirdNET confidence scores into probabilities is recommended
by the BirdNET authors ([Wood & Kahl
2024](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10336-024-02144-5)); calibration by
logistic regression on logit(score) is applied, for instance, by [Owens
et al. (2026)](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.01.729442).
[`calibrate()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibrate.md)
extends that approach with a hierarchical multi-species structure,

    tp ~ logit(conf) + (logit(conf) | species) + (1 | site:species)

because the same score corresponds to very different probabilities of a
true detection across species and sites. The candidate models are
compared by stratified k-fold cross-validation, which scores both
discrimination (AUC) and the predicted probabilities (log-loss, Brier
score, calibration intercept and slope);
[`select_calibration_model()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/select_calibration_model.md)
picks a model by the highest AUC or by the simplest model within one
standard error of the lowest log-loss, leaving out singular fits.

The selected model can also be fitted in a Bayesian framework with
‘brms’ (`engine = "brms"`), with an explicit prior, convergence
diagnostics, posterior predictive and prior sensitivity checks. Each
detection then gets the posterior probability that it is reliable, and
the uncertainty of the calibration can be propagated to the detection
histories and the community matrices
([`vignette("bayesian-calibration")`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/articles/bayesian-calibration.md)).

## Integration with crywolf

`clip_manifest.csv` and `validation_by_clip.csv` are the hand-off to
occupancy models with false positives.
[`vignette("crywolf-integration")`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/articles/crywolf-integration.md)
specifies their columns, types and the definition of an occasion;
example files are in `system.file("extdata", package = "sheepdog")`. Do
not pass the whole-recording clips of `"random_recordings"`
(`confidence = NA`) to the `validation` argument of
[`crywolf::fp_aggregate()`](https://provetelab.org/crywolf/reference/fp_aggregate.html):
they are the second method (manual annotation), not confirmations of
detections.

## From the scripts (v1.2.0) to the package (v2.0.0)

Up to v1.2.0 this repository held four R scripts. Version 2.0.0 turns
them into the sheepdog package, with English function names, arguments,
output columns and values. `NEWS.md` maps every script setting to its
argument and every old column to its new name. The package reads
manifests, validation tables and histories written by v1.2.0, so
validated data stay usable. The scripts are preserved in the [v1.2.0
tag](https://github.com/diogoprov/sheepdog/tree/v1.2.0).

## Authorship and citation

Developed by **Diogo B. Provete** (Universidade Federal de Mato Grosso
do Sul), from the protocol design of **Larissa S. M. Sugai** (Cornell
Lab of Ornithology) and **Liliana Piatti** (UFMS), within the FrogNet
project. Code written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic), with human
review and tests.

If sheepdog is useful in your work, please cite it (GitHub’s “Cite this
repository” button uses `CITATION.cff`):

> sample, validate and calibrate BirdNET detections for passive acoustic
> monitoring*. Zenodo. <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22696209>

# Package index

## Stage 1 - Validation data

Read BirdNET selection tables, select clips for manual review, and cut
and pack them.

- [`extract_validation_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/extract_validation_clips.md)
  : Build the validation clip set
- [`read_selection_tables()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/read_selection_tables.md)
  : Read BirdNET selection tables
- [`select_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/select_clips.md)
  : Select the clips to validate
- [`cut_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/cut_clips.md)
  : Cut the selected clips
- [`pack_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/pack_clips.md)
  : Pack the clips into one zip per species

## Stage 1 - After the review

Classify the reviewed clips and summarise precision, thresholds,
presence and retraining clips.

- [`post_validation()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/post_validation.md)
  : Summarise the manual validation
- [`classify_review()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/classify_review.md)
  : Classify the reviewed clips
- [`precision_by_bin()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/precision_by_bin.md)
  : Precision by confidence bin
- [`suggest_thresholds()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/suggest_thresholds.md)
  : Suggest a confidence threshold per species
- [`nightly_presence()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/nightly_presence.md)
  : Confirmed presence by night
- [`retraining_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/retraining_clips.md)
  : Positive clips for retraining
- [`plot_precision()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/plot_precision.md)
  : Plot the precision curves
- [`read_validation_tables()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/read_validation_tables.md)
  : Read and stack the validation tables
- [`build_training_set()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/build_training_set.md)
  : Build the training folders for BirdNET-Analyzer
- [`exclude_training_clips()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/exclude_training_clips.md)
  : Leave the training clips out of a manifest

## Stage 1 - Several reviewers

Split the clips among reviewers, measure their agreement and combine
their verdicts.

- [`assign_reviewers()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/assign_reviewers.md)
  : Assign the clips to several reviewers
- [`split_by_reviewer()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/split_by_reviewer.md)
  : Copy each reviewer's clips to their own folder
- [`reviewer_agreement()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/reviewer_agreement.md)
  : Agreement between reviewers
- [`consensus_verdicts()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/consensus_verdicts.md)
  : Consensus verdicts of several reviewers

## Stage 2 - Calibration

Calibrate confidence scores into probabilities of true detection and
build nightly detection histories.

- [`calibrate()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibrate.md)
  : Calibrate confidence scores and build detection histories
- [`read_validations()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/read_validations.md)
  : Read the validation tables for calibration
- [`calibration_models()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_models.md)
  : Candidate calibration models
- [`calibration_folds()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_folds.md)
  : Assign cross-validation folds for calibration
- [`compare_calibration_models()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/compare_calibration_models.md)
  : Compare calibration models by cross-validation
- [`select_calibration_model()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/select_calibration_model.md)
  : Select the calibration model
- [`fit_calibration()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/fit_calibration.md)
  : Fit the calibration model
- [`calibration_effort()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_effort.md)
  : Effort curve of the calibration
- [`score_detections()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/score_detections.md)
  : Score every detection with the calibration model
- [`detection_history()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/detection_history.md)
  : Nightly detection history
- [`summarise_history()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/summarise_history.md)
  : Summarise the detection history by site and species
- [`plot_calibration()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/plot_calibration.md)
  : Plot the calibration curves

## Stage 2 - Bayesian calibration

Fit the calibration with brms, check the prior and the fit, and
propagate the uncertainty to the histories and the matrices.

- [`calibration_prior()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_prior.md)
  : Example prior for a Bayesian calibration model
- [`prior_predictive_calibration()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/prior_predictive_calibration.md)
  : Prior predictive calibration curves
- [`calibration_diagnostics()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_diagnostics.md)
  : Convergence diagnostics of a Bayesian calibration model
- [`calibration_sensitivity()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_sensitivity.md)
  : Prior and likelihood sensitivity of a Bayesian calibration model
- [`plot_calibration_draws()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/plot_calibration_draws.md)
  : Calibration curves of posterior (or prior) draws
- [`calibration_ppc()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/calibration_ppc.md)
  : Posterior predictive checks of a Bayesian calibration model
- [`plot_calibration_ppc()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/plot_calibration_ppc.md)
  : Plot posterior predictive checks of a calibration model
- [`history_draws()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/history_draws.md)
  : Nightly detection histories over posterior draws
- [`occasion_draws()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/occasion_draws.md)
  : Detections of each occasion over the draws of the calibration
- [`community_matrices_draws()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/community_matrices_draws.md)
  : Community matrices over posterior draws

## Stage 3 - Community matrices

Effort-standardised site x month matrices from calibrated histories.

- [`build_community_matrices()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/build_community_matrices.md)
  : Write the community matrices
- [`community_matrices()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/community_matrices.md)
  : Community matrices from the detection history
- [`cell_status()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/cell_status.md)
  : Status of each site x species cell for the community matrices
- [`suggest_core_species()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/suggest_core_species.md)
  : Suggest the core species of the community matrices

## Occupancy models

Export the occasions, scores, reviewed clips and calibration draws for
occupancy models with false positives, such as those of crywolf.

- [`export_occupancy_data()`](https://provetelab.org/sheepdog/reference/export_occupancy_data.md)
  : Export the data of an occupancy model with false positives
